svg.aria-label: qrntn, set as quarantine with the struck vowels ghosted
svg.title: qrntn — ghosted-vowel lockup
svg.desc: The candidate against the plain wordmark. The full word is set; the vowels the name strikes out are held at 0.18, so the mark reads "quarantine" close up and "qrntn" at a glance. Same characters, two readings, and which one you get depends on how hard you looked — which is the flag's own inversion in type. No textLength here: tspans and lengthAdjust do not compose, so this relies on the mono advance rather than pinning it. OUTLINE THE TEXT before using this anywhere the font is not guaranteed to load.
